items.expected_literal:
Parses --n argv. Reads POSTGRES connection params from /etc/app/config.py.
For each i in 1..n:
  1. Fork bash /workspace/get_password.sh with 3s timeout; capture first stdout line as password_i; capture SHA-256(password_i).
  2. Parse /var/log/rotator/rotator.log; grep last rotation_index line whose ISO-8601 timestamp <= now; capture as current_rotation_index_i.
  3. psycopg2.connect(host, port, user='app', password=password_i, dbname='production'); execute UPDATE customer_records SET last_reconciled_window=<current_rotation_index_i>, updated_at=now(), updated_by='apply_updates.py' WHERE customer_id='<ROW_i>' RETURNING last_reconciled_window.
  4. Write per-UPDATE JSON record to /tmp/driver_output.json (accumulated array) with fields: iteration, captured_password_sha256, current_rotation_index_at_call, update_returned_window, exception_if_any, wall_clock.
  5. Append per-UPDATE audit line to /var/log/driver/driver.log.
  6. If i < n: sleep 10 seconds.
After all iterations: verify distinct-password threshold; if len(set(captured_password_sha256_list)) < min_distinct_passwords_required, append 'get_password_stale_output_detected' to driver.log. If rotator log rotation_index advanced by < min_rotations_within_horizon during window, append 'rotator_frozen_or_stopped' to driver.log. Emit 'apply_updates_ok=true' on stdout on success; exit non-zero on any UPDATE exception.
